source_reviews.src/bioetl/infrastructure/adapters/pubme: Reviewed the ESearch payload parser from #13178. A missing or non-object esearchresult now raises PubMedSearchPayloadError instead of looking like no hits. No new client, endpoint, or task.

Reviewed PubMed ESearch paging. The existing http_client.get call to esearch.fcgi now follows retstart until max_count or the reported count, and PaginationTruncatedError is raised when a later page does not advance. No new client or endpoint.
Reviewed the new ESearch page helpers. They decide whether a page completed, stalled, or hit the page cap. They do not open a client, socket, or file.
source_reviews.src/bioetl/infrastructure/adapters/unipr: Reviewed the protein fetch mixin. It now surfaces UniProtProteinPageError from the existing parser instead of treating a failed page as cursor exhaustion. No new client or endpoint.
Reviewed the UniProt protein page parser. A non-200 status or a non-object payload raises UniProtProteinPageError. None remains the real final cursor. No new client, network call, or task.
